parsed.reading: The name sounds like triumph made into a person: conquest, success, the crowning of struggle.
parsed.source: Lewis & Short, Latin Dictionary; de Vaan, Etymological Dictionary of Latin and the other Italic Languages

parsed.chain: vic-to-ria → vic / tor / ia; vic ~ vice, tor ~ tower/torus, ia ~ island/land
parsed.reading: A crooked tower on an island: a raised sign of power standing apart from ordinary ground.
The word is already its own translation: the state of having won, of being above defeat.
